description: Diagnose a sales drop: compares the last N days with the previous period, checks account health and returns likely causes plus suggested actions. Use for "why are my sales dropping?".

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

statuses.description: Amazon OrderStatuses to include in the comparison (SP-API enum, e.g. Shipped, Unshipped, PartiallyShipped, Pending, Canceled). Default: all of the former.

name: diagnose_sales_drop
